en.headline: Customs and firefighters seize 30,000 litres of illicit fuel
en.dek: A joint operation from 16 to 30 September broke seven cases, with nine people arrested and eight vehicles seized.
body: Customs and the Fire Services Department said a joint operation codenamed Strike, run from 16 to 30 September, broke seven illicit-fuel cases. Nine people were arrested and about 30,000 litres of illicit fuel and eight vehicles were seized, with a total estimated value of about 1.7 million dollars.

Customs said the haul included more than 16,000 litres of untaxed petrol and 14,000 litres of diesel. The vehicles were six private cars, a light goods vehicle and a cross-border tractor. Officers raided storage sites at rural iron sheds in San Tin and Tuen Mun on 22 and 28 September and seized about 12,000 litres of untaxed petrol there. They also broke five illegal filling points in Kowloon Bay, Kwun Tong, Kam Tin, Kwai Chung and Tuen Mun.

Chong Sin-han, commander of the Revenue Investigation Division 3 of the Customs Revenue Crimes Investigation Bureau, said the two stores were believed to be transit points, with untaxed petrol brought in by cross-border vehicles and then moved to illegal stations in the city. She said investigators believed operators had stockpiled fuel ahead of the National Day holiday, when cross-border freight is thinner. The eight men and one woman arrested were aged 25 to 53. Six were described as station operators, two as customers and one as a cross-border driver.

zh.headline: 海關消防聯合行動檢約3萬公升非法燃油
zh.dek: 代號「擊破」的行動於9月16日至30日進行，偵破7案，拘捕9人並檢獲8輛車。
body: 海關與消防處表示，雙方在9月16日至30日展開代號「擊破」的聯合行動，打擊非法燃油，共偵破7宗案件，拘捕9人，檢獲約3萬公升非法燃油及8輛車，總值約170萬元。
海關稱，檢獲物品包括逾1.6萬公升未完稅汽油及1.4萬公升柴油。車輛為6輛私家車、一輛輕型貨車及一輛跨境拖頭。人員在9月22日及28日於新田及屯門鄉郊鐵皮場搗破兩個儲存倉，檢獲共約1.2萬公升未完稅汽油，並在九龍灣、觀塘、錦田、葵涌及屯門搗破5個非法油站。
海關稅收罪案調查科稅收調查第三組指揮官莊倩嫻表示，調查顯示兩個儲存倉是走私汽油的中轉站，不法分子以跨境車輛運入未完稅汽油，再以流動車輛供應市內非法油站。她說，國慶假期跨境貨運較疏落，相信有人在假期前囤積燃油。被捕8男1女年齡介乎25至53歲，其中6人被指經營非法油站，兩人是顧客，一人是跨境車司機。
